State Bank Of India has informed the Exchange that the Committee of Directors , duly authorized by the Central Board of the Bank , at their meeting January 15, 2016 , inter-alia, authorized the Bank to seek shareholders approval and to write to GOI and RBI seeking their approval under Section 5 (2) of the State Bank of India Act , 1955 for extending the period of approval for raising equity capital upto Rs.15,000 crores till 31.03.2017 by way of FPO/ Rights issue/ES PS/ESOS/QIP/ADR/GDR or any other mode or a combination of these as may be decided at the opportune time or as may be approved by the GOI and RBI.
